findings.current: **[Exclusive Report] Hunter Go Jun, Ares Vice Guild Master at the Time, and 25 Others Confirmed Dead; Total Casualties Around 500**
findings.defect: The parenthetical 現 explicitly identifies Go Jun as the current Ares Vice Guild Master, but “at the time” recasts the title as a former or merely historical position.
findings.rationale: Preserving the current-status marker avoids changing Go Jun’s official position as reported in the headline.
findings.replacement: **[Exclusive Report] Hunter Go Jun (Current Ares Vice Guild Master) and 25 Others Confirmed Dead; Total Casualties Around 500**
findings.source: [단독 보도] 석고준 헌터(現아레스 부 길드장) 외 25명 사망 확인, 총 사상자 500여 명

findings.current: Two days had already passed since the day I remembered, and my face was plastered across the front page in enormous letters.
findings.defect: The source says an enormous image of his face occupied the front page; “in enormous letters” incorrectly turns the photograph into text.
findings.rationale: 대문짝만하게 describes the huge size of his pictured face, not the typography of the accompanying headline.
findings.replacement: Two days had already passed since the day I remembered, and an enormous photo of my face was plastered across the front page.
findings.source: 기억 속 그날로부터 벌써 이틀이 지나 있었고, 1면에는 대문짝만하게 내 얼굴이 박혀 있었다.

findings.current: **[Editorial by Lee Kanghee—Jin Taekyung: The Hero’s Hidden Side. The Devil’s Face.]**
findings.defect: The draft turns 주필, Lee Kanghee’s senior editorial title, into a generic article label and thereby removes his institutional authority.
findings.rationale: 주필 denotes the newspaper’s chief editorial writer, not merely the fact that the text is an editorial.
findings.replacement: **[Chief Editorial Writer Lee Kanghee—Jin Taekyung: The Hero’s Hidden Side. The Devil’s Face.]**
findings.source: [이강희 주필 - 진태경. 영웅의 뒷면. 악마의 앞면.]

findings.defect: Taekyung’s faint spoken “Ah” is omitted, leaving only silence and losing his immediate, disoriented reaction.
findings.rationale: The source includes an audible 아 before the President calls to him.

findings.defect: The established rendering for 천지창조 is incomplete.
findings.rationale: The binding terminology ledger specifies “The Creation (The Genesis)” for this exact title.

findings.current: I get that Lord Sibu-leol went to Ares Guild headquarters, but isn’t calling it a “storming” a bit much?
findings.defect: “Calling it a storming” is an unnatural nominalization and obscures that the commenter is disputing the verb used to characterize Taekyung’s entrance.
findings.rationale: 쳐들어갔다고 표현하는 건 questions whether describing his action as storming the headquarters is excessive.
findings.replacement: I get that Lord Sibu-leol went to Ares Guild headquarters, but isn’t saying he “stormed the place” a bit much?
findings.source: 근데 시부럴좌가 아레스 길드 본사 찾아간 건 알겠는데, 쳐들어갔다고 표현하는 건 오바 아님?

summary: The draft is broadly faithful, but it alters Go Jun’s stated title, misdescribes the front-page photograph, omits a vocal reaction, drops an editorial title, and has two localized terminology or phrasing issues.
